name: drover
description: drover: an autonomous GitHub Project board runner and its lane skills.

plugins.name: drover
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner: drover, drover-build, drover-qa, drover-review, drover-collect, visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (security pass on every PR; onboard adds Cloudflare's on-demand security-audit). Install with install.sh and drover skills install; drover onboard writes the project's .drover/config.json.
